issues.description: Aufgabe 05 (requested output) vs solution SQL disagree on the requested aggregate and output column order. The problem statement (problem_statement.md line 126) requires the average area per Landkreis plus the Landkreis name and its Regierungsbezirk. The provided solution (solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql line 1) instead selects regierungsbezirk, kreis and uses COUNT(flaeche) (count of rows) rather than AVG(flaeche) (average area). This returns the wrong aggregate and a different column order than requested, which will produce incorrect values and confuse students about which aggregation and column order to use.
issues.suggestedFix:
Change the solution to compute the average area and return the columns in the order requested (kreis, regierungsbezirk, average area). For example:

SELECT kreis, regierungsbezirk, AVG(flaeche) AS durchschnittliche_flaeche
FROM Gemeinde
GROUP BY kreis, regierungsbezirk
ORDER BY kreis;

This preserves the educational intent (average area per Landkreis, include Landkreis name and Regierungsbezirk, sorted by Landkreis name).
